title: Floating-point averages
description:
Work out an average and a square root with SSE scalar instructions.

```
values: 3 4 5 6
mean 4.5 -> printed as 4 and 50 hundredths
root of 2 x 10000: 14142
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
values: dq      3, 4, 5, 6
hundred: dq     100.0

        section .text
_start:
        pxor    xmm0, xmm0
        ; TODO

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `cvtsi2sd xmm1, qword [rel values + rcx*8]` / `addsd xmm0, xmm1` (lesson 7.01).
For two decimals, multiply by 100.0, convert to an integer, then divide by 100 with `div` for the whole part and remainder.
requirements: Convert the integers with `cvtsi2sd`, add with `addsd`, divide with `divsd`.
Print the whole part and two decimals by converting back with `cvttsd2si`.
stretch: Print the result with a proper decimal point for any number of places.
